items.title: Discovering and exploiting remote code execution in OpenCode (GHSA-632h-h47v-g4x4)
items.summary: Datadog Security Labs discovered GHSA-632h-h47v-g4x4, a vulnerability in OpenCode's upgrade endpoint that, under certain conditions, allowed malicious webpages to execute code on developers' machines.
items.summary_html: Datadog Security Labs discovered GHSA-632h-h47v-g4x4, a vulnerability in OpenCode's upgrade endpoint that, under certain conditions, allowed malicious webpages to execute code on developers' machines.
